searchText: Hi guys what's happening here? https://pyrmont.beaconcha.in/blocks That's across all proposers, not one single team/node starting on block 194784 all orphaned/missing is it an issue with pyrmont or beaconcha.in? <@!97774605351010304> not that i am aware of <@!514429265001971732> I can see those blocks in my node, so I don't think they are orphaned the pyrmont explorer was down ~12h ago, caused some issues. We'll look into it tomorrow 👍 yep, in addition to that I switched to a new prysm-node and at that moment something might have caused some issues anyway I am not 100% sure if there is not a bug in our exporter regarding orphaned blocks, will definitely look closer into this Is pyrmont working correctly? These two validators have deposited, but they have been stuck "pending" since: <https://pyrmont.beaconcha.in/validator/ac0bf28147ec8ecafebd2d524963728acd3fca6e590626ceb3e6a4f5cf8f57b8c6b259f29745952cb5ce62f04a4ae36c> <https://pyrmont.beaconcha.in/validator/b6fd24a8b74ddf4b92d086d4ec15f991bf3c5c4d67dbe80378d677ef0486eda4376d2057703b40f5a884910d3d6619fa> The beaconcha.in site has said "around 1 hours" and "a few secs ago" for many hours now. <@!301186049323958275> I do not see those validators in my node either the deposit seems to be only 4 hours ago it should take minimum 8 hours for it to appear in ETH2 but yes, beaconcha.in is not displaying that info correctly now One is from 10 hours ago. That's still fine, you need 8 hours from the lookahead to ETH1, and after that you need to be voted in The period of voting lasts 64 epochs, So 8 hours plus some unknown amount of time beyond that? it's not really unknown on pyrmont cause the network is voting very well, we can estimate it well let' s see the current blocks are voting for the ETH1 block 3928807 The older validator here made it' s deposit in block 3929932 so it won't be voted in this period Worst case, if only limited by eth1 voting, not by a validator queue, would be 8 hour follow distance + 8 hour voting period (i.e. very first block of voting period, have to wait till end, if there's eth1 consensus at all among validators). Or 8+4 if voting is optimal but bad deposit timing. hence it will be aprox 33 epochs after the next epoch multiple of 64 That' s about epoch 6113 ooops, sorry 6177 So that is 230 minutes, almost 4 hours for it to be voted in It would be cool if these estimates were available in various tools. That's actually not hard to implement perhaps beaconcha.in can include it. Of course there's no way of estimating when you will be active since this depends on the deposits I may be wrong by a few epochs cause there are a few missed blocks of on pyrmont, but it shouldn't be much more than 4 hours since that post above
